In [[704 BBY]], the [[Expansionist Oligarchy/Legends|Expansionist Oligarchy]] exploited its administrative authority over the newly-created [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] to abuse the region's resources and peoples. The resulting '''civil unrest and political scandal''' forced the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to intervene.
